phase: P1 ninth increment: opt-in management and independently supervised settlement composition
implemented: Explicit MANAGEMENT_WITH_SETTLEMENT only, entries=false and SANDBOX. Legacy and MANAGEMENT_ONLY defaults unchanged. Controller directly owns management child and settlement owner; no child-spawned settlement grandchildren.

WorkerGroup retains handles after partial startup, release failure and unconfirmed stop. All members must be READY. Stop hints broadcast before bounded member stops. ChildWorker uses lock-free cooperative flags and retains a possibly started process on start failure.

Independent non-daemon settlement owner polls active jobs without DB, health or notification I/O; selects only with no active job. FINANCIAL and OUTCOME attempt cursors persist across jobs, including failed/timed-out attempts.

Financial commit fences full account scope, binding version, epoch/token and MANAGE permission inside the same SERIALIZABLE transaction. Temporary role is restored exactly; route/registry SHARE locks remain until commit. No route lock across venue GET. Optional guard does not change unwired old paths.

New financial jobs disable synchronous outcome recording. Already SETTLED replays require scoped committed settlement journal, avoiding repeated cash audit after IPC loss. OUTCOME is database-only and does not decrypt venue credentials.

Only financial progress participates in settlement controller health. Stale research is separately visible via snapshot.progress_fresh; fresh empty research cannot hide financial failure. Flat source and confirmed stop are still required for account handover.
Shutdown stops local workers before route DB access, retaining handles and the caller's lease context while stop is unconfirmed. Metadata write failures cannot skip local stopping.

qa.boundary: One isolated temporary PG/Redis harness at a time; Unix socket pinned to v2_isolated_qa. Dedicated V2 conftest denies external TCP; spawned PG helper reinstalls denial. Synthetic GET-only venue and synthetic fills, no runtime credentials or exchange calls.
qa.scope: 52 selected related test files, not all repository tests, deployed cgroup acceptance, real exchange end-to-end testing or profitability validation.

intermediate_runs.note: Initial role/fence/thread/group/management/bounded-process regression; before full-scope preflight and final composition corrections.

Actual adapter integration exposed settled replay cash reaudit and financial job synchronously generating derived outcome; third fixture expected direct EXECUTION_FENCED but inventory correctly converted denied GET into FINAL_ACCOUNT_NOT_RECONCILED.

Corrected adapter replay/independent outcome, complete scope preflight and shutdown; includes real owner-thread/spawn/fenced-PG normal and ignored-SIGTERM timeout cases. Predates final diagnostic-only OUTCOME health correction.

52-file regression. All 10 failures were in the offline management recovery fixture, which bypassed ChildWorker.__init__ and omitted its new startup_failure field. Production hashes unchanged. Fixture initialized that field; no behavior/assertion weakened.

corrections: Settled financial replay now requires both scoped SETTLED status and existing v2_settlements evidence; no repeated venue cash audit or risk release.
DirectionalSettlementStage.settle retains default record_outcome=true for existing callers; new financial job explicitly chooses false.
Final-commit revocation test now revokes after network evidence acquisition and before the financial transaction, while a separate real stage test still covers revocation during network.

Independent review found stale derived outcomes would block controller account handover via healthy(); excluded them from authority health and added independent freshness diagnostics plus real PG controller/group transition tests.
Startup full-scope preflight now fails before READY on missing narrow metadata SELECT grants; existing-role upgrade script provided but not applied.
Management recovery fake ChildWorker bypassed __init__ and omitted startup_failure=None. Added only the missing field; its 17 pure tests passed after correction. Production source was unchanged.

selected_regression.note: Not a second full 52-file run: after a single fixture-only initialization correction, all 10 failed cases and directly related contracts were rerun in 14 files. Unchanged production and new-test hashes checked. Overlapping counts must not be summed.

limits: Task selection/bootstrap occurs with no active child and can still block; unknown stop retains ownership and prohibits replacement. Standard connector timeouts are not a hard OS/network bound.
Deadlines require the independent owner to remain scheduled. Synchronous spawn, OS stalls and server-side session lock release are not guaranteed by a local process result.
Standalone supervisor SIGKILL has no PDEATHSIG guarantee; repository systemd cgroup configuration is not tested live in this increment.
Controller main-loop DB/health blocking before finally, and advisory lease loss on connection failure, require later process-group acceptance.
Management and financial work still share protocol account locks. This is bounded recovery under tested conditions, not zero contention.
Intermediate observational journals may commit independently; final financial fence does not retroactively revoke those observations.
Progress timeout should cover the configured maximum settlement job cycle; extreme allowed timing combinations can produce a conservative stale signal.
Typed entry worker, full process-group lifecycle, historical scale and slow-dependency acceptance, and two deterministic strategy-family comparisons remain unfinished.
next: Wire typed entry worker and frozen decisions, then full process-group acceptance before any activation or strategy evidence window.
